summary_en: DAIICHI JITSUGYO completed cancellation of 500,000 shares (1.5% of shares outstanding before cancellation) on October 15, 2026, reducing issued shares to 32,259,200.
title_en: Notice Regarding Completion of Cancellation of Treasury Stock
translation_en_brief: On October 15, 2026, DAIICHI JITSUGYO completed the cancellation of 500,000 treasury shares pursuant to Article 178 of the Companies Act, following a board resolution adopted on September 24, 2026. The cancelled shares represented 1.5% of the shares outstanding prior to cancellation. After the cancellation, the company's issued share count decreased to 32,259,200 shares.
